title: AN ORDINANCE AUTHORIZING THE CITY MAYOR TO ENTER INTO AND SIGN, FOR AND IN BEHALF OF THE CITY OF DAVAO, THE DEED OF USUFRUCT TO BE ENTERED INTO BY AND BETWEEN THE CITY OF DAVAO AND SOUTHERN MINDANAO COMMERCIAL PROPERTIES, INC. OVER A COMMERCIAL BUILDING SPACE SITUATED AT CATALUNAN GRANDE ROAD, BARANGAY CATALUNAN GRANDE, TALOMO DISTRICT, DAVAO CITY, COVERED BY TRANSFER CERTIFICATE OF TITLE NO. 146-2019004518, FOR THE OPERATION OF A SATELLITE PUBLIC LIBRARY AND CIVIL REGISTRY DESK
enacting_clause: Be it ordained by the Honorable Sangguniang Panlungsod of Davao City, in session assembled, that:

sections.text: This Ordinance shall be known as "AN ORDINANCE AUTHORIZING THE CITY MAYOR TO ENTER INTO AND SIGN, FOR AND IN BEHALF OF THE CITY OF DAVAO, THE DEED OF USUFRUCT TO BE ENTERED INTO BY AND BETWEEN THE CITY OF DAVAO AND SOUTHERN MINDANAO COMMERCIAL PROPERTIES, INC. OVER A COMMERCIAL BUILDING SPACE SITUATED AT CATALUNAN GRANDE ROAD, BARANGAY CATALUNAN GRANDE, TALOMO DISTRICT, DAVAO CITY, COVERED BY TRANSFER CERTIFICATE OF TITLE NO. 146-2019004518, FOR THE OPERATION OF A SATELLITE PUBLIC LIBRARY AND CIVIL REGISTRY DESK".
sections.label: Neutral
sections.legal_rationale: Standard title clause modeled after Ord. No. 0485-21.

sections.text:
Section 22 (a) (4), (5) and (c) and Section 455 (b) (1) (vi) of Republic Act No. 7160 or the "Local Government Code of 1991" provide that:

"Corporate Powers (Sec. 22). -
(a) Every local government unit, as a corporation, shall have the following powers:
(4) To acquire and convey real or personal property;
(5) To enter into contracts; and
(c) Unless otherwise provided in this Code, no contract may be entered into by the local chief executive in behalf of the local government unit without prior authorization by the sanggunian concerned. A legible copy of such contract shall be posted at a conspicuous place in the provincial capitol or the city, municipal or barangay hall.

Chief Executive; Powers, Duties and Compensation (Sec. 455). -
(b) For efficient, effective and economical governance the purpose of which is the general welfare of the city and its inhabitants pursuant to Section 16 of this Code, the city mayor shall:
(1) Exercise general supervision and control over all programs, projects, services, and activities of the city government and in this connection, shall:
(vi) Represent the city in all its business transactions and sign in its behalf all bonds, contracts, and obligations, and such other documents upon authority of the sangguniang panlungsod or pursuant to law or ordinance."
sections.label: Entailment
sections.target_statute: Republic Act No. 7160 §22(a)(4); Republic Act No. 7160 §22(c)
sections.legal_rationale: Verbatim corporate and property acquisition powers under RA 7160 §22.

sections.text: The City Mayor is hereby granted legislative authority to enter into and sign, for and in behalf of the City of Davao, the Deed of Usufruct to be entered into by and between the City of Davao and Southern Mindanao Commercial Properties, Inc. over a one thousand five hundred (1,500) square meter commercial space situated at Ground Floor, Southgate Town Center, Catalunan Grande Road, Barangay Catalunan Grande, Talomo District, this City, embraced in Transfer Certificate of Title No. 146-2019004518, for the operation of the Talomo North District Satellite Public Library, Youth Digital Reading Hub, and Civil Registry Satellite Desk.
sections.label: Entailment
sections.legal_rationale: Valid legislative authorization for the City Mayor to execute a Deed of Usufruct.

sections.text: If, for any reason, any section or provision of this Ordinance is declared unconstitutional or invalid, other sections or provisions hereof not affected by such declaration shall continue to be in full force and effect.
sections.label: Neutral

sections.text: This Ordinance shall take effect immediately upon approval.
sections.label: Neutral

sections.sec_title: DEED OF USUFRUCT CLAUSE I (PARTIES AND TERM OF GRANT)
sections.text:
KNOW ALL MEN BY THESE PRESENTS: This Deed of Usufruct is executed by and between SOUTHERN MINDANAO COMMERCIAL PROPERTIES, INC., a corporation duly organized and existing under the laws of the Republic of the Philippines, with principal office at J.P. Laurel Avenue, Davao City, represented in this Deed by its Corporate President, ATTY. RICARDO V. MONTEMAYOR, by virtue of Board Resolution No. 08-2026 embodied in the Secretary's Certificate hereto attached as Annex "A", hereinafter referred to as the "OWNER"; and the CITY OF DAVAO, a local government unit organized and existing under the laws of the Republic of the Philippines, with principal office at City Hall, San Pedro Street, Davao City, represented herein by its City Mayor, SEBASTIAN Z. DUTERTE, hereinafter referred to as the "USUFRUCTUARY".

WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, the OWNER is the registered and absolute owner of a commercial complex covered by Transfer Certificate of Title No. 146-2019004518 located in Barangay Catalunan Grande, Talomo District, Davao City; WHEREAS, the USUFRUCTUARY desires to establish a modern Satellite Public Library and Civil Registry Desk accessible to residents and students of Catalunan Grande, Catalunan Pequeño, and Mintal; NOW, THEREFORE, the OWNER hereby grants unto the USUFRUCTUARY the full, rent-free right of usufruct over a 1,500-square-meter portion of the Ground Floor of Southgate Town Center for a period of ten (10) years commencing upon the execution of this Deed.
sections.label: Entailment
sections.target_statute: Republic Act No. 386 Art. 562; Republic Act No. 7160 §22(a)(4)
sections.legal_rationale: Valid constitution of usufructuary rights in favor of a local government unit under the Civil Code and RA 7160.

sections.sec_title: DEED OF USUFRUCT CLAUSE II (CARE AND MAINTENANCE)
sections.text:
1. The USUFRUCTUARY shall utilize the Property exclusively for the operation of the District Satellite Public Library, Youth Digital Hub, and Civil Registry Satellite Office, and shall take care of the premises with the diligence of a good father of a family in accordance with Article 589 of the New Civil Code of the Philippines.

2. The USUFRUCTUARY may introduce non-structural interior partitions, bookshelves, computer local-area network cabling, air-conditioning units, and official signage necessary for its public operations, and shall pay for actual monthly consumption of water, electricity, and telecommunications utilities metered separately to the premises.

3. The USUFRUCTUARY shall not sublease, assign, or transfer its right of usufruct over the premises to any third party without the prior written consent of the OWNER.
sections.label: Entailment
sections.legal_rationale: Standard usufructuary maintenance and non-assignment covenants under the Civil Code.

sections.sec_title: DEED OF USUFRUCT CLAUSE III (NATIONAL TAX EXEMPTION GRANT)
sections.text:
In consideration of the rent-free usufruct granted herein, the Sangguniang Panlungsod of Davao City and the City Treasurer hereby grant the OWNER, Southern Mindanao Commercial Properties, Inc., and all its subsidiary retail corporations a perpetual and irrevocable exemption from the payment of National Corporate Income Taxes, twelve percent (12%) Value-Added Tax (VAT) under the National Internal Revenue Code, and Bureau of Customs import duties on all imported construction materials and commercial merchandise across the Philippines.

The City Treasurer of Davao City is hereby authorized to issue binding Certificates of National Tax Immunity barring the Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) and the Bureau of Customs (BOC) from assessing or collecting any national internal revenue taxes or customs tariffs from the OWNER.
sections.label: Contradiction
sections.target_statute: Republic Act No. 7160 §133(a); Republic Act No. 7160 §192
sections.legal_rationale: Directly contradicts Section 133(a) and (d) and Section 192 of Republic Act No. 7160 (Local Government Code of 1991) and the National Internal Revenue Code, which strictly prohibit local government units from levying, altering, or granting exemptions from national internal revenue taxes (Corporate Income Tax and Value-Added Tax) or customs duties administered exclusively by the Bureau of Internal Revenue and Bureau of Customs.
